verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI documents general natural-language debugging and troubleshooting (gh-3). Configurable MCP servers could, in principle, connect it to external runtime tooling (gh-5, gh-19). Nothing shows it attaching to, inspecting or controlling a live running web application, so live debugging would depend on third-party MCP tools. Missing for 10: first-party live-app or browser/runtime inspection, a documented debugger or devtools integration, and hands-on evidence of debugging a running web app.
